title: CEO Hometown Preference in Corporate Environmental Policies
near_miss_reason: Staggered CEO-turnover design (plants switching into or out of the CEO's hometown at 21 distinct turnover years, 1994-2017, with same-firm non-switching plants as controls; plant FE plus firm-year, state-year and industry-year FE). Every reported turnover column fails: the main DiD (Table 3) and its event study (Figure 3) are PPML with a time-varying plant-sales control and a post main effect, and the only OLS turnover columns (Table 4, share of waste managed on site) add time-varying sales, lagged waste and lagged chemical-count controls.
eligible_reason: No reported specification qualifies: PPML (nonlinear) in Table 3 and Figure 3; time-varying controls and a post main effect in the OLS columns of Table 4; Tables 2, 5-10 are plant-year or county/hospital PPML regressions on hometown-radius indicators with controls.
design_notes: sample_turnover_matched.dta: 16,941 plant-years, 701 plants in home-to-nonhome cohorts (type1) and 661 in nonhome-to-home cohorts (type2). Turnover (post_event0) years among treated plants: 21 distinct years 1994-2017 (largest: 2004 with 20 plants, 1995 and 2007 with 12). FE: $fe = firm_year estab_state_year estab_ind_year plus plant_id; the firm-year FE make same-firm non-switching plants the comparison group. Main cross-sectional evidence (Table 2) is ppmlhdfe of plant releases on radius1/d_hometown (plant within the CEO's hometown radius) with firm-year and plant-state/industry-year FE. Noncompliance (Table 7) uses xtlogit.
main_or_robustness: main (turnover DiD is the paper's identification test)
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Distinct turnover years among treated plants (first year with post_event0 = 1), computed from sample_turnover_matched.dta.

specs.exclusion_reason: PPML (nonlinear); time-varying control std_sales_db1 (pseudo NETS plant sales); post main effect as extra regressor
specs.treatment_var: d_hometown1 (= post x plant switching from hometown to non-hometown)
specs.treatment_definition: Firm CEO turnover; d_hometown1 = 1 in post-turnover years for plants that were in the outgoing CEO's hometown and are not in the incoming CEO's hometown; controls are other plants of the same firm in the matched cohort.
specs.notes: Dropping std_sales_db1 and post and switching to OLS would give a TWFE candidate with firm-year FE; not a reported column.

specs.exclusion_reason: PPML (nonlinear); time-varying control std_sales_db1; post main effect
specs.treatment_var: d_hometown2 (= post x plant switching from non-hometown to hometown)
specs.treatment_definition: As T3_c1 for plants that become the new CEO's hometown plants.

specs.exclusion_reason: PPML event study; time-varying control std_sales_db1; post main effect
specs.treatment_var: pre_event2 pre_event1 post_event0 post_event1 post_event2 (and new_* for the nonhome-to-home sample, line 12)
specs.treatment_definition: Event-time indicators around the CEO turnover for switching plants; window -2..+2.

specs.exclusion_reason: time-varying controls (std_sales_db1, lagged log waste produced, lagged chemical count); post main effect
specs.reported_location: Table 4, turnover panel (OLS columns, code order est5 est6 est3 est4)
specs.notes: The only linear (OLS) turnover specifications in the paper; two columns.

data_access: partial (TRI public; manually collected CEO hometowns shipped; NETS proprietary variables replaced by pseudo-variables; Compustat-derived firm variables)
data_files_note: readme.pdf: because NETS is proprietary, NETS variables are replaced by pseudo-variables with the same mean and SD (3_Table_regression.do lines 16-21: pseudo_sales_db = sales_db + noise). Outcomes (TRI releases) and treatment (hometown status) are original.
data_provenance_note: Outcome and treatment variables are original; the NETS-based control std_sales_db1 (plant sales) and plant employment are noise-added pseudo-variables. A control-free TWFE would use only original variables.
software_notes: Stata (ppmlhdfe, reghdfe, coefplot, mmerge, estout); SAS for Figures 1-2.
priority_note: Near-miss (secondary category). Reported columns cannot be reproduced exactly because of pseudo NETS controls; an OLS TWFE without controls is feasible from the shipped file.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text in data/text). Package contents read, no code run.
